title: Put values in order
summary: R: Put values in order. Use decreasing = TRUE.
introduction: sort returns a vector in order from smallest to largest by default.
learningObjectives: Put values in order with R

blocks.text: Install R. Save an example as lesson.R and run Rscript lesson.R, or paste it into the R console.
sort returns the values in increasing order: 3, 5 and 8.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: sort returns a result; keep it if you want to reuse it.
